name: Seikon no Qw○ser ~Souma Donin~
original_name: 性痕のク○イサー～聖乳貪淫～
source:
Based on "The Qwaser of Stigmata".

Play the role of a hero in search of a sacred substance giving Maria Magdalen, and enact a plasma-bursting holy spurge of milky, sopping wet retribution! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE063852.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
本作以《圣痕炼金士》为题材。

你将扮演一名英雄，寻找能够赐予圣乳的“生神女”，以迸裂的等离子与四处喷溅的乳汁，降下湿润而畅快的神圣制裁！

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE063852.html]DLsite英文站[/url]]
